name: Trump of the Oliphaunt

stealth.details: (master) to notice the tension of a low vibration forming in the area from the imminent release of the Oliphaunt's trumpet

disable: DC 38 Arcana check (expert), DC 38 Maelstrom-lore check (expert), DC 38 Occultism check (master), DC 38 Religion check (master) to recognize and shore up the area against the localized planar instability causing a connection to the Oliphaunt of Jandelay. Four successes are needed to strengthen the area enough against the instability to end the hazard.
reset: The area becomes unstable again after 24 hours.
routine:
(1 action) Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 36 Fortitude save save. A creature with the slowed condition from this hazard takes a –2 circumstance penalty on further saves against this effect.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature takes 2d6+6 sonic damage and is Deafened for 1 round.
Failure The creature takes 4d6+13 sonic damage and is Slowed 1 for 2 rounds.
Critical Failure The creature takes 8d6+26 sonic damage and is Slowed 2 for 2 rounds.

items.name: Bone-Shattering Rhythms
items.text:
Trigger Three or more characters enter the area of planar instability

---
Effect Pent-up magical energy from another world begins to release in waves of overwhelming sound. The hazard rolls initiative.

text: An overwhelming trumpeting sound vibrates and suffuses the area, causing everything to slow.
